input.summary: Add Licensee Data ownership and a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back to customisations Licensee pays for
input.comment: [Playbook] Article III gives Licensor ownership of everything, including the bespoke front end and customisation work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), and our only rights terminate with the Agreement. We have added a licence-back on those paid-for deliverables and confirmed that our own trade and order data stays ours; our playbook position is that we own what we pay for, and this fallback leaves Licensor's platform ownership intact.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) as between the parties, Licensee owns all right, title and interest in and to all data, orders, trade records and other information submitted, generated or derived by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data"), together with all of Licensee's pre-existing intellectual property, and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers any Licensee Data or any Licensee intellectual property to Licensor; and (ii) with respect to any customization, unique client front end or other development work performed by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including under Article VII(b)) (the "Custom Deliverables"), Licensor hereby grants to Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid-up license to use, modify and sublicense the Custom Deliverables for Licensee's business purposes, which license shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
